test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

As of now, they have finished the __construction of the ground flour.__
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct substitution is option 2) **"construction of the ground floor".**
 
• The** sentence appears** to be discussing a construction project.
 
• **In this context,** the term **"ground floor"** is the most appropriate because it refers to the first or main level of a building.
 
• The original underlined word,** "flour",** is a typo.** It refers **to a type of food substance and does not fit in the context of construction.
 
• The other options "flavor", "flower", and "flounder" also don't fit the context because they do not have meanings related to building construction.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'As of now, they have finished the **construction of the ground floor.'***
